ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Prior to filing, screen every proposed shareholder, director, supervisor, senior manager, final beneficiary, and close associate against the Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission consolidated sanctions list, the Executive Yuan national terrorist list, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN list, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and adverse media databases. Apply a risk-based approach with enhanced due diligence for all domestic and foreign politically exposed persons and persons in state-owned-enterprise leadership roles. Retain all screening evidence, including exact-match logic, fuzzy-match results, and the database source and snapshot date, for at least five years. Any PEP, sanctions, or terrorist-financing hit requires immediate filing of a Suspicious Transaction Report with Taiwan's Anti-Money Laundering Division and suspension of the formation process until a satisfactory resolution is documented.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) One-Stop Online Company Registration System: Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Review Module
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name must be in Traditional Chinese only; Simplified Chinese is not accepted at the registry. English names are not part of the official registered name in Taiwan, but if an English name is used for banking, trademark, or contracting purposes, a declared English/Traditional transliteration must be provided. The four-tier naming convention is: (i) mandatory legal form suffix such as Limited Company or Company Limited by Shares; (ii) a distinctive trade name that is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing approved name; (iii) a business scope descriptor in Traditional Chinese; and (iv) permitted phonetic or semantic transliteration of foreign brand marks into Traditional Chinese. The MOEA examination covers exact-match similarity, transliterative similarity, and visual/auditory confusion against the name database.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The MOEA pre-check approval is valid for 180 days and cannot be extended; before expiry, the applicant may refile the same name under a new reference number only if the name is not yet occupied. Upon rejection, the applicant must file a written administrative appeal with the MOEA Administrative Appeals Committee within 30 days under the Administrative Appeal Act, setting out the name conflict, supporting search evidence, and why the rejected name is distinctive; if administrative appeals are exhausted, judicial review may be pursued in the Taipei High Administrative Court.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as a statutory registered office. Taiwan's Company Act and the National Taxation Bureau require a bona fide fixed operational address where administrative records, tax invoices, payroll, and corporate seals are maintained. For a video game anti-cheat middleware joint venture, banks and the tax authority will reject a virtual office or commercial mailbox address because the company must demonstrate commercial substance in Taiwan. A shared office or serviced office with a dedicated lease, physical signage, and evidence of daily operations may be accepted; a pure mail-forwarding address will be rejected and can trigger refusal of bank account opening and an investigation for false registration.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-high, approximately 35%, for a newly formed Sino-foreign joint venture in information-security middleware during the first 12 months after incorporation. Inspection checklist: (1) company name plaque posted at the registered address; (2) valid lease agreement and fire-safety compliance documentation on site; (3) payroll and employment records demonstrating on-site staff; (4) board meeting minute books and resolutions; (5) UBO book and beneficial ownership registers; (6) accounting books, invoices, and bank statements; (7) actual presence of business during working hours; and (8) data infrastructure or cloud service documents evidencing Taiwan operational substance. Unannounced inspections may be conducted by the National Taxation Bureau, local municipal tax authorities, and the MOEA company registrar.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of the Republic of China (Taiwan), as amended, Articles 128-153, 192-216, and 419-439; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, Article 5; Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area, Article 73.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commercial Affairs, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (R.O.C.) - Company Registration One-Stop Service Center and online registration system.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Registration Application and Articles of Incorporation, together with the Capital Verification Report and the Company Name Pre-approval Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a company limited by shares engaged in ISIC 6201 in Taiwan. However, the entire issued share capital must be lawfully subscribed and paid. Subscription funds must be deposited into a temporary bank account opened in the company name; a bank contribution deposit certificate and a Taiwan-licensed CPA capital verification report must be submitted to the registry. The funds must remain in the account until the Company Registration Certificate has been issued. No separate blocked escrow account system is created under Taiwan law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
The First Board of Directors Resolution of JV Limited, a Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture organized as a company limited by shares, adopted by unanimous written consent on [Date], in accordance with the Company Act and the Articles of Incorporation.
WHEREAS, the shareholders have subscribed for the entire issued share capital of the Company as shown in the shareholders register; and
WHEREAS, the Company will engage exclusively in the development, licensing, and maintenance of video game kernel-level anti-cheat and integrity middleware under ISIC 6201 and NAICS 541511; and
WHEREAS, the Department of Commercial Affairs requires the Company to adopt a registered office and to designate statutory officers before registration is completed;
NOW, THEREFORE, be it RESOLVED as follows:
1. Share Capital Subscription. The authorized share capital of the Company is fixed at NTD [X], divided into [Y] ordinary shares with a par value of NTD 10 per share, and all authorized shares are issued and subscribed by the shareholders named in the shareholders register. The Board ratifies the receipt of all subscription payments into the Company's temporary capital subscription account and directs the Chairman to obtain the bank deposit certificate and the certified public accountant's capital verification report and to file them with the competent registry.
2. Registered Office. The registered office of the Company shall be and is hereby adopted at [Address], Taiwan. The Chairman is authorized to execute the lease, landlord's written consent, registered-office consent forms, and any related government filing required by the registration authority.
3. Banking and Payment Rails. The Company shall open and maintain corporate bank accounts at [Bank, Branch]. The Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, and Chief Financial Officer are designated as authorized signatories. Any two signatures are required for transactions above NTD [X], and one signature is sufficient for transactions below that amount. The Board approves the use of Swift Wire transfers and Stripe as treasury and payment rails, and authorizes all related account mandates, wire instructions, and online banking token requests.
4. Statutory Officers. [Name] is elected Chairman of the Board and statutory responsible person of the Company; [Name] is appointed Chief Executive Officer; [Name] is appointed Chief Financial Officer; and [Name] is appointed Corporate Secretary. Each officer shall hold office until the next annual general meeting or until earlier death, resignation, or removal.
5. Implementation. All officers are directed to make all registrations, filings, and notifications, and to obtain all permits required for lawful commencement of business. No business may commence before the Company Registration Certificate is issued and all applicable approvals are in effect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Screening and Pre-Approval for Foreign and Mainland China Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (R.O.C.) - online investment approval system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply online to the Investment Commission under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals and Article 73 of the Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area. Submit the executed joint venture agreement, board resolutions of each investing shareholder, a detailed business plan describing the kernel-level anti-cheat middleware and data-processing flows, audited financial statements for the preceding fiscal year, and certificates of incorporation of both the Chinese and Taiwan shareholder entities. Because Mainland China investment is present, the Commission will conduct an additional national-security and industry-eligibility review. The Commission may impose undertakings on data processing, customer vetting, or localization; such undertakings become binding conditions of approval and must be exhibited in the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Completed investment approval application form
Executed joint venture agreement
Business plan covering ISIC 6201 and NAICS 541511
Audited financial statements of all corporate shareholders for the most recent fiscal year
Certificates of incorporation of each investing entity
Board resolutions of each investing shareholder authorizing the investment
Passport or national ID copies of individual investors and authorized representatives
Proof of source funds and bank reference letters
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a deficiency letter or asks for clarification, the applicant must submit supplementary documentation within 15 days. If the application is queried, the Commission will issue a written list of missing items; a cure notice must be filed through the same online portal. If the investment is rejected, the applicant may restructure the investment and file a new application with revised ownership or scope, or may file an administrative appeal to the Executive Yuan within 30 days of written rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Business Scope Pre-Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Name Reservation System, Department of Commercial Affairs, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (R.O.C.).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the company name reservation portal and apply for a Chinese-language company name with an optional English alias. The proposed business scope must be stated in the exact standardized wording accepted by the system, using only ISIC 6201 computer programming and gaming middleware activities; no residual expressions such as other or miscellaneous are permitted. The system will search existing company names, trade names, and trademarks for identical or confusingly similar results. The name approval certificate is valid for six months and may be extended once for a further six months. Download the certificate and attach it to the subsequent incorporation filing. The reserved name may not be assigned or transferred to another entity.
required_dossiers: Company name reservation application form
Standardized business scope description
Proof of identity or power of attorney for the filing agent
Company Name Pre-approval Certificate after grant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected because of conflict, the applicant may resubmit immediately with one or two alternative names at no additional fee. If the system requests clarification, the applicant has five working days to respond online. If final rejection is issued, a new reservation application with a materially different name must be filed, and the prior certificate may not be extended or transferred.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Contribution Deposit and Independent CPA Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Not a government window; deposit is made at a licensed Taiwan commercial bank, and the resulting capital verification is reported through the CPA to the MOEA company registration system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the name approval certificate and, where applicable, the investment approval certificate, open a temporary capital contribution deposit account at a commercial bank authorized to operate in Taiwan. The account title must clearly show the prospective company name followed by Capital Contribution Account. Each shareholder must remit the full subscription amount in New Taiwan Dollars; foreign currency transfers must be converted through the banking system and relevant foreign-exchange purchase records retained. The bank will issue a Capital Contribution Deposit Certificate. A Taiwan-licensed independent certified public accountant must review the bank certificate, account statement, remittance vouchers, and shareholder subscription ledger, and then issue a Capital Verification Report. The capital must remain in the account until the Company Registration Certificate is issued; early withdrawal renders the registration process invalid and exposes the promoters to regulatory inquiry.
required_dossiers: Company Name Pre-approval Certificate
Investment approval certificate if Mainland China capital is involved
Bank Capital Contribution Deposit Certificate
CPA Capital Verification Report
Shareholder subscription list and payment vouchers
Foreign exchange settlement records for inbound remittances
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or CPA queries the source or sufficiency of funds, provide wire transfer receipts, foreign-exchange purchase records, or an affidavit explaining the lawful source of funds within seven days. If the bank refuses to certify the deposit, close the account, redeposit into an eligible bank, obtain a fresh deposit certificate, and issue a new CPA verification report.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Registration and Issuance of Company Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commercial Affairs, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (R.O.C.) - Company Registration One-Stop Service Center and online filing system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the full incorporation registration package through the category-specific company registration interface of the Department of Commercial Affairs or the one-stop regional office. Include the signed Company Registration Application, executed Articles of Incorporation, minutes or written consent of the first shareholders meeting electing the directors and supervisor, the First Board of Directors Resolution, landlord consent and building identification for the registered office, the bank contribution certificate, the CPA capital verification report, the name pre-approval certificate, the investment approval certificate where required, and identification documents of all directors, supervisors, and shareholders. The Department will examine the statutory filing requirements, verify the business scope, and transmit the approved record to the National Taxation Administration for automatic tax registration. Upon approval, the Company receives the Company Registration Certificate and business tax registration number. The company must then arrange official company chops and final bank specimen signatures.
required_dossiers: Signed Company Registration Application
Articles of Incorporation executed by all promoters
First shareholders meeting minutes or written consent electing directors and supervisors
First Board of Directors Resolution
Landlord consent or lease agreement for registered office
Bank Capital Contribution Deposit Certificate
CPA Capital Verification Report
Company Name Pre-approval Certificate
Investment approval certificate if Mainland China capital is present
Photocopies of identification documents for directors, supervisors, and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Department issues a rectification notice, correct and refile the affected documents within 15 days. If the registration is suspended for incomplete information, the applicant may request an urgent completeness review after submission. If an application is rejected, the promoters may submit a revised application curing all stated defects, or file an administrative appeal to the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days of the written rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Tax, Uniform Invoice, and Compliance Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (R.O.C.) - regional national tax bureau.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Company Registration Certificate has been issued, confirm the automatic tax registration and uniform invoice registration with the local National Taxation Administration office. Verify that the Company has been assigned a uniform invoice serial and, if necessary, submit an application for the uniform invoice usage registration. Execute the company chop specimens and file bank signing mandates at the corporate bank. Because the Company is engaged in pure digital software and gaming anti-cheat middleware under ISIC 6201, no environmental impact assessment, civil defense fire permit, industrial factory registration, or manufacturing operating license is required. The officers must still confirm that the leased office carries a valid commercial fire safety certificate and general building compliance. If the anti-cheat service processes personal data, the company should implement a privacy policy and cybersecurity controls under the Personal Data Protection Act and related guidance; these are operational data-governance obligations rather than physical operating licenses.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate
Tax registration number confirmation
Uniform invoice registration application if applicable
Company chop specimen records
Bank account mandate and authorized signatory forms
Commercial fire safety certificate for the leased office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the taxation authority issues a query or requests additional particulars, file a supplementary statement through the regional tax bureau portal within seven days. If a late-filing fine has been proposed, the Company may file a voluntary correction and request mitigation. Any incorrect registration data should be cured immediately through a revised company registration filing at the Department of Commercial Affairs.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable; the undertaking is a pure digital software and anti-cheat middleware service under ISIC 6201, generating no industrial wastewater, no volatile organic compound point-source emissions, and no hazardous waste streams.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to pure digital software operations. The underlying activity does not involve physical manufacturing, chemical processes, assembly, or warehousing, so no civil defense fire permit, structural load inspection, or specialized workplace safety license is required. General Occupational Safety and Health Act obligations for office premises remain applicable, and the landlord's commercial fire safety certificate should be maintained on file.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Taiwan Ministry of Finance, Taxation Administration; online services via the MOF Tax Portal (tax.nat.gov.tw) and the e-Invoice Integration Service Platform; local administration is handled by the appropriate local National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign non-resident entity establishing a Taiwan foreign-invested JV limited company or branch must first obtain any required investment approval from the Investment Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs; then complete company or branch registration with the Ministry of Economic Affairs to obtain the statutory 8-digit Company Uniform Number. Using that Uniform Number, the entity must complete tax registration with the local National Taxation Bureau within the statutory period after business commencement, using the prescribed tax registration application and supporting constitutional documents of the entity, and thereafter file Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax and Business Tax returns under the same Uniform Number. For a non-resident entity without Taiwan establishment that only supplies cross-border services into Taiwan, the route is a simplified withholding registration or cross-border e-service registration with the National Taxation Bureau; no separate VAT ID is issued because the Uniform Number is the sole tax identifier for Taiwan tax purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Taiwan does not offer check-the-box elections or hybrid mismatch elections; a Taiwan JV limited company is taxed at entity level as a Profit-Seeking Enterprise under the Income Tax Act, and no group tax consolidation election is available for unrelated or externally owned group members.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added and Non-Value-Added Business Tax (VAT; Business Tax Act)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general VAT registration threshold: every profit-seeking enterprise selling goods or services in Taiwan is subject to Business Tax. A small-scale business with average monthly sales below the uniform-invoice threshold of New Taiwan Dollars 200,000 may be taxed under simplified assessment at a 1% business tax rate; once sales exceed that threshold, standard 5% VAT applies and Uniform Invoices must be issued.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Taiwan mandates the Uniform Invoice system. Electronic Uniform Invoices must be generated through an approved Turnkey connection or certified value-added center and uploaded to the Ministry of Finance e-Invoice Integration Service Platform within the statutory transmission deadline. The Taiwan system is not a real-time fiscal-memory clearance regime and does not use a Chinese Golden-Tax DPI stamp, but the Taxation Administration operates centralized anti-fraud data mining and cloud-invoice number certification for all electronic invoice transactions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Article 7 of the Business Tax Act zero-rates exported goods and services supplied by a Taiwan taxable entity to an overseas customer or for offshore use. For goods, the goods must be physically exported from Taiwan customs territory through a customs export declaration. For the gaming anti-cheat middleware supplied as software or cloud services, zero-rating is available when the services are performed by the Taiwan entity for a foreign buyer, the contract and performance evidence confirm no material domestic consumption in Taiwan, and the service fees are received in foreign exchange from outside Taiwan. The zero-rating claim also depends on timely repatriation and settlement or credit of export foreign exchange within the statutory limit.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration or customs export Bill of Entry showing customs approval number and actual export date
Bill of lading, air waybill, or other transport documentation evidencing physical departure of exported goods
Foreign exchange inward remittance certificate, foreign-currency deposit statement, or authorized-bank foreign exchange settlement certificate proving actual receipt from the overseas buyer
Zero-rated service agreement or contract and evidence of offshore use and acceptance for digital middleware service exports
Purchase order, license statement, or service activation record identifying the overseas counterparty and the taxable fee amount
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is audited against customs export records, transport evidence, service contracts, and bank foreign-exchange inward remittance records. If export proceeds are not received within 180 days and no prior regulatory approval is obtained, the zero-rating is disallowed, 5% VAT is assessed retrospectively, and late interest and penalties are imposed. False zero-rating declarations, forged export or remittance documents, fabricated foreign customers, and understatement of export proceeds are treated as Business Tax evasion and can trigger clawback of underpaid tax, administrative penalties of multiples of the evaded tax, suspension or cancellation of the entity's tax status, and criminal liability under the Tax Evasion and Punishment Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) (CBC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Taiwan operates a managed floating exchange rate regime in which the New Taiwan Dollar is broadly convertible for current account items such as software licensing, royalties, and trade in services. Capital account flows, by contrast, remain controlled: equity injections from mainland China require prior approval from the Investment Commission and registration in the Central Bank's foreign exchange declaration system. Profit repatriation by a joint venture is lawful only after the annual financial statements are audited by a Taiwan CPA, tax is paid, and the dividend remittance is matched to the original investment permit. There is no general surrender requirement for current receipts, and NTD conversion is done at market rates through CBC-designated banks. However, the CBC monitors large inward and outward remittances, and any transaction without a real economic purpose or required permit will be rejected. Cross-clearing through offshore EMIs or non-banks is not permissible; all treasury flows must be traceable through the designated banking channel. Offshore NTD deliverability is limited, and onshore forward markets provide the main hedging mechanism for corporates.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender period and no mandatory conversion ratio in Taiwan. Export proceeds must be routed through a CBC-designated bank and declared in the Foreign Exchange Declaration System upon settlement. The exporter may retain 100% of export foreign currency in a Foreign Currency Deposit Account or convert any portion to NTD at free-market rates. Statutory timeline: immediate declaration at receipt; mandatory conversion ratio: 0%.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Legally infeasible. Taiwan's banking and foreign exchange regime does not recognise offshore EMI licences. Only CBC-designated banks can conduct foreign exchange intermediation and open foreign-currency or New Taiwan Dollar corporate accounts. Offshore EMIs such as virtual banks or cross-border fintech money transmitters may not hold a Taiwan corporate account or process capital-account wires. Stripe is not a treasury or clearing rail; it may aggregate consumer card payments only if an in-country licensed acquirer settles the funds to the JV's bank account. All principal liquidity and clearing must be maintained on the CBC-regulated domestic banking system.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At least one statutory director and a beneficial owner representative must complete an in-branch KYC interview at the chosen bank. Remote opening is not accepted as a standalone option. A notarised and consular-authenticated power of attorney may permit the remote appointment of a second signatory, but banks require the local Taiwan director to appear physically with the company chop, original constitutional documents, and board minutes. For the mainland Chinese shareholder, authenticated corporate authorisation and passport copies can be couriered, but the bank's compliance committee will require a direct video interview with the mainland legal representative and a written explanation of the cross-strait ownership purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mainland China ownership concentration and cross-strait ultimate beneficial owner opacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Approved Taiwan Investment Commission permit, notarised JV registry extract, full chain-of-title shareholding register above 10%, certified UBO declaration, PRC parent charter and business license, two-year audited parent financial statements, source-of-funds affidavit with six-month corporate bank statements from the PRC parent, and negative sanctions, PEP, and adverse media search results for all named shareholders and directors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-face-to-face account opening and offshore board control by a Shanghai-based parent.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed board resolution appointing a Taiwan resident director and signatory, notarised and apostilled power of attorney, Taiwanese registered-office lease and utility bill, corporate ownership and control chart, payroll records for local staff, recorded video interview with the mainland legal representative, and a bank reference letter from the PRC parent's current bank confirming transaction profile.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Anti-cheat and kernel-level middleware may be screened as surveillance or dual-use technology, creating export-control and data-residency concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Official product description and end-use certificate confirming video game anti-cheat and integrity middleware, ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2 Type II reports, data protection impact assessment showing no Taiwan personal data leaves the jurisdiction, Taiwan Bureau of Foreign Trade export classification certificate where applicable, no military or intelligence end-user declaration, and a Taiwan legal opinion on technology export compliance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Structuring red flags from Chinese capital injections split into multiple small wires to avoid CBC reporting thresholds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Single lump-sum inbound wire via SWIFT MT103 from the PRC parent's registered foreign-currency account, PRC SAFE cross-border ODI registration certificate, Investment Commission permit, Taiwan CPA capital verification report, CBC foreign exchange declaration confirmation for the full injection, board minutes approving the capital funding plan, and source-of-funds documentation evidencing legitimate corporate liquidity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The PRC parent must complete the People's Bank of China and SAFE ODI registration and purchase foreign exchange at a Chinese bank using the cross-border direct investment purpose code. The Taiwan JV must secure a mainland-investment permit from the Taiwan Investment Commission before any funds are wired. The remittance should be a single SWIFT MT103 from the parent's corporate foreign-currency account to the JV's Capital Escrow Account at a CBC-designated bank. The wire narrative must reference the Investment Commission permit number and the CBC foreign exchange purpose code for capital contribution or equity injection. Upon arrival, the receiving bank generates the foreign exchange declaration, and the CPA performs capital verification by matching the permit, SWIFT confirmation, inward remittance evidence, company registry data, and board-approved registered capital schedule.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier payments, licensing fees, royalties, and tax-paid dividend remittances. Use Commercial Letters of Credit for hardware and infrastructure procurement and Documentary Collections for lower-value trade documents. Each outward remittance must carry a CBC foreign exchange declaration, the underlying contract or invoice, and tax documentation where required. Settlements should run through the designated Taiwan bank's USD, CNY, and CNH correspondent network. Stripe may be used only for low-value recurring card collections from end-user gaming customers, not for corporate disbursements or foreign exchange clearing.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/TWD forward contracts with a maximum tenor of one year and a documented underlying trade, royalty, dividend, or intercompany loan exposure
Cross-currency swaps between CNY/CNH and USD/TWD for documented intercompany financing or long-term investment exposure
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) only with non-resident counterparties or under a CBC-approved exception; resident-linked NDFs are restricted
Vanilla FX options and swaps embedded in a bank-approved corporate hedging programme; cryptocurrency derivatives and speculative binary products are not permitted

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of Company Directors, Supervisors, Managers and Major Shareholders (Company Act Article 20-2)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (via National Business Administration Portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Every calendar year from January 1 to March 31, reflecting the company records as of December 31 of the preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing, late filing, or false filing: New Taiwan Dollar (NTD) 50,000 to NTD 500,000 fine per violation; a further order to file within a prescribed period; continued non-compliance results in cumulative fines per successive failure (no direct administrative strike-off, but the competent authority may exercise discretionary enforcement and, for deliberately evasive cases, initiate an investigation; long-term non-compliance may be treated as a serious governance defect and can contribute to grounds for dissolution under other provisions).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Settlement Return (Income Tax Act Article 71)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Finance, National Taxation Bureau (local bureau having jurisdiction over the company's registered address)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 1 to May 31 of the following tax year for calendar-year taxpayers; for fiscal-year companies, within five months after the fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing: a surcharge of 1% of the tax due for every two days of delay, capped at 30%; failure to file after a notice: estimated assessment with an additional 20% surcharge and interest; repeated non-filing can lead to compulsory collection, seizure of assets, and the tax authority may request suspension or deregistration of the business for flagrant violations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Withholding Statements (salary and other payer's income statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Finance, National Taxation Bureau (same local bureau)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before January 31 each year for payments made in the preceding calendar year; for business income, by the same deadline.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to timely file: NT$1,500 to NT$15,000 fine per occurrence; if the taxpayer fails to file after a written notice, progressive penalties apply; in more severe cases, the amount of withheld tax may be assessed against the payer plus a penalty equal to the withheld amount (as applicable). No direct strike-off, but continuous statutory breaches can be referenced in dissolution proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting and Approval of Financial Statements (Company Act Articles 170, 228-230)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders in general meeting (minutes recorded in the company's Minute Book; no government filing required unless a public company or where capital changes are registered)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of each fiscal year (normally by June 30 for calendar-year companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene within the statutory period: a fine of NT$20,000 to NT$100,000 imposed on the responsible person by the competent authority, plus an order to convene within a set deadline; continued non-convenance gives rise to per-term fines and, in severe cases, the competent authority may enforce dissolution under Article 10 of the Company Act.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Taiwan Company Act Article 20 and the Standards for Company Capital and Revenue Thresholds, a non-public company must have its financial statements audited and certified by a certified public accountant (CPA) if its paid-in capital exceeds NT$30 million or its annual operating revenue exceeds NT$100 million. Public companies and companies in regulated industries (e.g., banking, insurance, securities, or designated critical sectors) are subject to mandatory CPA audits regardless of size. Companies that do not meet the thresholds may still be required to submit externally reviewed financial statements if so ordered by the central competent authority or for financing purposes.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Public companies: Taiwan-IFRS (TIFRS) as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission. Non-public companies: Business Accounting Act and Business Accounting Treatment Regulations (consistent with IFRS for SMEs); such companies may elect to apply TIFRS in full once adopted.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not operate a freestanding UBO filing. Under the Company Act Article 20-2, every company must submit an annual electronic report identifying directors, supervisors, managers and all shareholders owning 1% or more of the outstanding shares; the filing period is January 1 to March 31 each year covering data as of the preceding December 31. In addition, under the Money Laundering Control Act, a company must maintain an internal register of beneficial owners (controlling persons) and update that register within 30 days of any change in ownership or control. This combination creates a de facto annual confirmation of ultimate beneficial ownership.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minutes of Shareholders' Meetings and Board Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – USD 1,500 per year for a registered office address or local compliance agent in Taiwan
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – USD 8,000 per year for a mandatory or voluntary CPA audit
